external_narratives.summary: Imperial War Museums register entry for the memorial to 415, 429, and 432 Squadrons RCAF at the former East Moor airfield site near Sutton-on-the-Forest. The memorial sundial cairn commemorates 640 RCAF aircrew who lost their lives during operations from the airfield.
key_details: 640 RCAF aircrew lost from this airfield

external_narratives.summary: 415 Squadron Association page documenting annual memorial services at the East Moor memorial cairn. The sundial cairn was installed in 1990 at the village pound in Sutton-on-the-Forest by Canadian veterans of the three RCAF squadrons.
key_details: Annual memorial services attended by Canadian veterans

external_narratives.summary: Memorial record for the 415, 429, and 432 Squadrons RCAF memorial at Eastmoor Airfield. The sandstone and Westmoreland slate sundial cairn was erected by Canadian veterans in remembrance of their fallen comrades.
key_details: Sandstone base with Westmoreland slate sundial
Purchased and erected by Canadian veterans

external_narratives.summary: Village community page about the annual East Moor memorial service. Describes the ongoing relationship between the village and Canadian veterans and their families who return annually to commemorate the 640 aircrew lost.

local_contacts.role: Local authority responsible for memorial upkeep

memorial_details:
Name: 415 429 and 432 Squadrons RCAF Eastmoor Airfield
Type: Sundial
Description: Sandstone Base on which is mounted a Westmoreland slate base, plinth and sundial. Inscription on the base and column. Badge of the RCAF on front face and 429 Squadron on the rear face. Badged of 415 Squadron on left side.and 432 Squadron on right.
Inscription: BASE, FRONT FACE: THIS MEMORIAL IS DEDICATED TO ALL WHO SERVED AT EASTMOOR/ IN WORLD WAR II. MANY OF WHOM GAVE THEIR LIVES AND IN/ GRATITUDE TO THE PEOPLE OF YORKSHIRE WHO WELCOMED THEM. BASE, REAR FACE: ERECTED BY THEIR FAMILIES AND FORMER COLLEAGUES/ DEDICATED THIS 2ND DAY OF JUNE 1990 FORTUNAE NIHIL/ NOV 1942 - AUG 1943 BASE, RIGHT FACE: SAEVITER AD LUCEM/ SEP 1943 - MAY 1945 BASE, LEFT FACE: AD METUM/ JULY 1944 - MAY 1945 Base of Gnomen: RAF EASTMOOR 54, 04'N 01.05'W
Location: Junction of roads from Stillington to York. The sundial occupies a small garden which has been created out of the former village pound. Sutton On The Forest Hambleton North Yorkshire YO61 1EQ England
Grid Ref: SE 58878 64762
Coordinates: 54.075430675230,-1.101644018433
Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/45/340/large_29901_inscription.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/171/953/large_29901.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/45/341/large_29901_dial.jpg

BASE, REAR FACE: ERECTED BY THEIR FAMILIES AND FORMER COLLEAGUES/ DEDICATED THIS 2ND DAY OF JUNE 1990 FORTUNAE NIHIL/ NOV 1942 - AUG 1943 BASE, RIGHT FACE: SAEVITER AD LUCEM/ SEP 1943 - MAY 1945 BASE, LEFT FACE: AD METUM/ JULY 1944 - MAY 1945 Base of Gnomen: RAF EASTMOOR 54, 04'N 01.05'W
Squadrons: 429 Squadron, 415 Squadron, 432 Squadron

remembrance.service_description: Annual memorial service at East Moor cairn. Representatives of the Royal Canadian Air Force attend, including officers from 415 Squadron. Programme includes visits to Commonwealth War Graves near Harrogate and guided tours.

events.description: Three Canadian officers from 415 Squadron attended. Photos provided by Anthony Prowde.
